take a item from the refactor lists in the kolboo project and implement it (first check that it wasn't done yet already). once done, delete the item from the refactor doc it was taken from, commit it and push it

but only do the refactor if you think that it is a good idea. if you start working on it and you see that its not high value and its more work than its worth or it makes things more complicated than they are already, then dont do it
